item.title: 'Not our war': Palestinians caught in the crossfire of Middle East war
item.summary: Four women were killed in the occupied #WestBank following missile fire from #Iran - the first Palestinian victims of the Middle East #war since it started on February 28. For Palestinians, it is yet another conflict they find themselves caught up in, with little protection.

item.title: No, Iran didn't publish a 'list' of 11 American cities to target
item.summary: A video claiming that Iran published a list of 11 American cities it plans to target has gone viral since it was first posted on Instagram on March 3. We found the origin of this list, and it turns out that it has nothing to do with Iran.
